Name: Safe Lightning Redux
Author: Shockah
Description:
[size=6]TL;DR:[/size]
[size=4]Never worry about lightning strikes again! Prevents lightning from striking any tiles or fruit trees.[/size]

Compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10631]Better Lightning Rods[/url].

[size=6]Configuration[/size]
The mod has [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] support. You can also edit the [font=Courier New]config.json[/font] file manually.

You can configure:
[list]
[*]Whether tiles are safe from lightning (includes crops)
[*]Whether fruit trees are safe from lightning
[*]When to use the "big lightning" audiovisual effect (Never / When supposed to strike / When actually strikes / Always)
[/list]
[size=6]Other info[/size]
You can find the source code [url=https://github.com/Shockah/Stardew-Valley-Mods/tree/master/SafeLightning]here[/url].
